definitions.explanation: The interior design and finishing of a building or vehicle, including walls, floors, ceilings, and fixtures.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{内装|ないそう}がおしゃれだ。
examples.english: This shop has stylish interior decoration.

examples.japanese: {内装|ないそう}{工事|こうじ}に{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}かかる。
examples.english: The interior work will take one month.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}の{内装|ないそう}が{革|かわ}でできている。
examples.english: The car's interior is made of leather.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {内|ない} (inside) + {装|そう} (outfit, decoration). Literally "inside outfit" - the interior finishing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{内装|ないそう}{工事|こうじ} (interior construction work)
・{内装|ないそう}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (interior contractor)
・{内装|ないそう}を{リフォーム|りふぉーむ}する (to renovate the interior)
・{内装|ないそう}がおしゃれ (stylish interior)
・{車|くるま}の{内装|ないそう} (car interior)

CONTRAST WITH {外装|がいそう}:
・{内装|ないそう}: interior decoration (inside)
・{外装|がいそう}: exterior, facade (outside)

RELATED TERMS:
・{外装|がいそう} (exterior)
・{外壁|がいへき} (exterior wall)
・インテリア (interior - loanword, broader scope including furniture)
・{壁紙|かべがみ} (wallpaper)
・{床材|ゆかざい} (flooring material)
